items.title: Submit Widerspruch against rejection of travel cost reimbursement
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
items.computation: Letter posted 25.06.2025 (Wednesday) by a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse), a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, which uses the 4-day delivery fiction for letters posted on/after 1 Jan 2025. Counting calendar days from the posting day (day 0, not counted): 26.06 (day1), 27.06 (day2), 28.06 (day3), 29.06 (day4) → deemed delivered Sunday, 29.06.2025. For social-law bodies the delivery day itself is not moved even if it falls on a weekend. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) then runs from the day after delivery and ends, per §§ 187, 188 BGB / § 26 SGB X, on the day of the following month with the same number as the delivery day: 29.07.2025 (Tuesday). That day is neither a weekend day nor a public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.
